name.value: Vanguard Morningstar US Total Market Shares Index ETF
name.note: Name on Vanguard's fact sheet dated 31 Aug 2026 (the latest published for VTS on 19 Oct 2026); the ASX company list shows 'Vanguard Morningstar US Total Mkt Shares Index ETF'. Earlier name: Vanguard US Total Market Shares Index ETF (still used in Vanguard's 25 Sep 2026 distribution announcement). The ASX listing is a CHESS Depositary Interest (CDI) over the US-domiciled Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF (NYSE: VTI), which Vanguard renamed Vanguard Morningstar Total Stock Market ETF in 2026.

index.note: Formerly the CRSP US Total Market Index (Vanguard says the CRSP indexes were rebranded to Morningstar after Morningstar acquired CRSP; name change expected July 2026). Before 3 Jun 2013 the benchmark was the MSCI US Broad Market Index.

mer.note: Management cost on the fact sheet dated 31 Aug 2026 (the US fund's expense ratio)

yield.note: Trailing 12 months of cash distributions / NAV on 16 Oct 2026, both in US dollars: US$3.9482 (0.9508 + 0.9982 + 1.0437 + 0.9555, ex-dates 22 Dec 2025 to 28 Sep 2026) / US$374.06 NAV. Distributions are declared in US$ per CDI and paid to Australian holders in A$, gross of US withholding tax. Vanguard's 1-year income (distribution) return was 1.25% to 30 Sep 2026 (1.27% to 31 Aug 2026 on the fact sheet).

franking.note: No franking credits: US-domiciled fund holding US shares; distributions are subject to US withholding tax instead

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here. Vanguard's fact sheet says 'ETF listed on ASX 12 May 2009'.

currency.note: The ASX CDIs trade in AUD; the underlying US fund's NAV and distributions are in USD (distributions are paid to Australian holders in AUD).

inception.note: Inception of the US fund (Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF, NYSE: VTI), 24 May 2001; the ASX listing is a CDI cross-listing of that fund, listed on the ASX 12 May 2009 per Vanguard (8 May 2009 per ASX company data).
